column1: # OWASP ZAP rules for the DAST jobs (.github/workflows/dast.yml, via .github/scripts/dast-scan.sh).
# Passed to zap-baseline.py / zap-full-scan.py with -c, and read by .github/scripts/security-gate.mjs.
# Format, one rule per line, TAB-separated:   <plugin id>
# Only IGNORE changes what the gate counts, and the gate REFUSES an IGNORE without a reason.
# Add one only for a reviewed false positive: say what ZAP saw, why it is not a vulnerability
# here, who reviewed it and when. A real finding is fixed, or left failing for the owner to
# decide; it is never ignored here to make the job green.
# Pass/fail is NOT decided by this file: the gate reads ZAP's risk (High / Medium / Low /
# Informational) against SECURITY_GATE_SEVERITY_ZAP / SECURITY_GATE_SEVERITY. WARN/FAIL here
# only change what ZAP prints in its own summary.
# Reviewed 2026-09-25 against the CI-local instance: no false positive found, nothing ignored.
# What ZAP reported then (all below the default "high" threshold) is listed in
